providers.name: anthropic
providers.capability: LLM-assisted column and unit normalization - mapping a messy client run sheet onto the canonical schema, tolerant of unusual or ambiguous headers.
providers.fallback: The deterministic offline synonym+units mapper in kalos.normalize (offline_plan) still runs, so normalization works, just less tolerant of unusual headers.

providers.name: bionemo
providers.capability: Real ESM-2 protein-sequence embeddings from a hosted NVIDIA BioNeMo endpoint (NVIDIA_API_KEY), plus pulling gated Hugging Face checkpoints (HF_TOKEN) - this is a SLOT for a future integration, not a working BioNeMo client today.
providers.fallback: kalos.features.protein already runs real ESM-2 embeddings via the public, non-gated facebook/esm2_t6_8M_UR50D Hugging Face checkpoint (ESM2Embedder), which needs no token; the lean k-mer embedder (KmerEmbedder) covers the fully offline case.

providers.name: ollama
providers.capability: A model running on this machine through Ollama answers assistant questions and revises SOP draft prose; nothing is sent off the machine when the URL is local.
providers.fallback: Without a model the assistant still gives the next step for each campaign and drafts SOPs from the record; asking questions is turned off.
